messages:
Alex Chen: Quick check — for /v1/generate structured outputs, do we standardize on omitting optional fields or returning them with null? Our frontend parser chokes if a key is missing. Also thinking about a vendor content-type for schema versioning. cc @Maria Gomez @Samir Patel

Maria Gomez: Prefer omitting optional fields. Clients should be tolerant IMO. We should add a top-level "schema_version" and publish the JSON Schema in the API docs.

Samir Patel: Frontend reality: missing keys = errors unless we explicitly handle them. For arrays/objects we can return [] / {} to be safe. For optional strings/numbers null is easier than absent for our current parser.

Jin Park: We can be explicit in the schema. Example snippet:```json
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_version": {"type": "string"},
    "result": {"type": ["object", "null"],
      "properties": {
        "text": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
        "tokens": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": {"type": "string"}}
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "required": ["schema_version"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

Alex Chen: Would using nullable types like above break older clients? Also propose Content-Type: `application/vnd.redwood+json; version=1` (and keep `application/json` as fallback). Example curl:```bash
curl -H "Accept: application/vnd.redwood+json; version=1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

CI Bot: CI: schema validator failed on PR #412 — error: "additionalProperties" violation for `metadata` field. Tests: https://ci.redwood/integration/412 (fyi)

Maria Gomez: Proposal to resolve: 1) Backcompat rule: never remove existing fields, mark deprecated in docs. 2) New optional fields: they MAY be omitted; clients MUST accept missing or null. 3) Collections: prefer returning empty array/object over null. 4) Scalars: null is acceptable for unknown/unset. 5) Add `schema_version` top-level and bump for breaking changes. 6) Use vendor content-type for explicit versioning. Anyone object?

Samir Patel: Sounds good. I'll make frontend tolerant of both missing and null for the short term. :+1:

Alex Chen: I'll update the API contract doc and add this JSON Schema snippet + tests to the repo. Will open a PR and ping the group when ready.

Jin Park: I'll adjust client SDKs to prefer `schema_version` and accept vendor content-type.

CI Bot: TODO: add integration test cases for missing/null/empty variations — assigned to api-tests.

Alex Chen: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the decision record.
